Name: Spool_RimWidth
Comments: Width of one of the rims of your spool

Name: Holder_Thickness
Comments: Thickness between the spool and outer wall of the holder (Recommended 10mm)

Name: Holder_Height
Comments: Height of the holder from the bottom (Recommended Max: Spool Diameter / 2)

Name: Label_TitleHeight
Comments: Height of title text on label

Name: Label_SubTitleHeight
Comments: Height of subtitle text on label

Name: Row_ArrayNumber
Comments: Changes the amount of holders in one row. Adjust based on print bed size (Will not copy labels)

Name: Holder_FilletSize
Comments: Changes the size of the fillet on the bottom of the holder

Name: Screw_ThreadWidth
Comments: Width of the threads on your screws or simply the "M" number (eg. M3)

Name: Screw_HeadHeight
Comments: Height of the head of your screws

Name: Screw_ThreadLength
Comments: Length of the threads on your screws

Name: Screw_HeadWidth
Comments: Width of the head of your screws
